claim_boundary: This protocol validates only the unignited hydrogen pressure-peaking consequence submodel for a confined, vented enclosure. It does not validate station filling, cascade/compressor control, dispenser operation, outdoor dispersion, ignition, or emergency-action effectiveness.

freeze.source_selection_rule: Use every experiment with parseable synchronized pressure and mass-flow channels and documented vent geometry; do not select cases by observed agreement.
freeze.case_exclusion_rule: Exclude only when the source metadata or raw file is irrecoverably missing, corrupt, or lacks the declared pressure/mass-flow/vent metadata; report every exclusion with its reason.
freeze.parameter_rule: Use enclosure volume, vent area, release conditions, sample interval, and calibration constants from the source metadata/raw documentation. No case-specific parameter fitting is allowed.
freeze.model_rule: Run the repository's declared pressure-peaking consequence model with a fixed ideal-gas hydrogen mass/energy balance and documented vent outflow closure; no per-case tuning after raw inspection.

secondary.name: directional_peak_bias
secondary.pass: report mean signed error and 95% bootstrap interval

metrics.aggregate_rule: A confirmatory submodel screen requires at least 6 eligible cases, >=80% of eligible cases passing both primary metrics, and no unreported exclusion. Otherwise report exploratory or failed status.
metrics.uncertainty: Report raw sampling interval, calibration/metadata uncertainty where supplied, and bootstrap 95% intervals over eligible cases.
